coverage: All nine castelli. The retained geoBoundaries source represents 2017, not a 2026 boundary survey. External display edges are reconciled to the existing Italian enclave outline. Area is calculated from the display geometry; no local population or economic data is inferred.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.

displayAlignment.reference: Existing detailed Italy first-level enclave ring
displayAlignment.policy: Clip external slivers and assign uncovered edge fragments to the nearest existing castello. Internal source divisions are retained; the shared national outline is identical to Italy.
